components.purpose: Covers the 'title over a full-width photo' requirement — its Heading field provides the page title, and setting Background Type to 'Background Image' with an uploaded image in BackgroundImage gives the full-width photo background. This sits at the top of the page.

Covers the 'Upcoming events' heading — this is the generic header/section-heading component (modelID 25, not the global site Header), whose Heading field would be set to 'Upcoming events', with the optional Description field available if any intro copy is needed.
Covers the 'free-text list of dates' — a free-form rich text area where the event dates can be entered as a simple list (bullets or lines of text) without needing a structured content model.
